reason: A DeepSeek Harness UI plugin focused on selectable skins, custom local wallpapers, and related appearance controls persisted in the browser.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供皮肤切换、自定义本地壁纸以及透明度和模糊调节功能。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with selectable skins, custom local wallpapers, and opacity and blur controls.

capabilities: Adds wallpaper selection and visual controls to settings
Stores user-selected wallpaper data in browser IndexedDB
Persists theme and display preferences in localStorage
Modifies theme tokens and adds a background layer to the web UI
